name: Tom Kha Kai
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 stalks lemongrass, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) pieces or split lengthwise
2 x 1-inch (5 x 2.5 cm) cube galangal, sliced thin
3–4 mini Thai bird chilies, finely chopped

steps: Bring stock and coconut milk to a boil.
Add lemongrass, galangal, chilies, sugar, and pepper.
Add onion, tomato, chicken bits, and mushrooms.
Keep at a rolling boil for 4 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat.
Stir in lime juice and soy sauce.

culture.text: Tom kha kai, tom kha gai, or Thai coconut soup is a spicy and sour hot soup with coconut milk in Thai cuisine.
